contract.intent: Constrain ann's writers in CODE so an out-of-folder write is unrepresentable: every write path derives from the addressed node's canonical folder (a store node handle), never from a caller-supplied path. lock! and supersede! lose their free path arguments. The AGENTS.md rule is convention only — this makes it structural.
acceptanceCriteria: Node handle: store.resolveNode(id) is the only id→folder mapping — it returns an opaque NodeDir (canonical folder under .ann/journey/legs) and refuses anything not under the store's legs root
Writers take the handle: appendEvent(node, …) and every task write derive their file path as join(node.dir, <fixed relative>); no caller passes or re-derives a path string
lock! drops the free path: it takes the handle + an artifact-relative name, resolves it inside the node's own artifacts/ dir, and refuses a file outside that folder
supersede! names its successor by node id + artifact name (resolved via resolveNode), not a raw path — remaining the one sanctioned cross-node writer
Proven green: existing suite passes, ann check stays at the accepted baseline (no new findings), and a test demonstrates an out-of-folder write target is refused/unrepresentable
expectedOutputs: lock! and supersede! with no free path argument
test proving out-of-folder writes are unrepresentable
